annotations.title: Change a Google Ads automated rule

description: Change any part of a rule; anything not passed keeps its value. Never switches it on or off. If the rule is ON and the new version can raise spend, it needs confirm:true plus confirmScope for the NEW version. Free.

actions.description: what it does on each match

allowSharedBudget.description: allow changing a budget shared by several campaigns

limit.description: REQUIRED for an increase: the highest value it may ever reach. A floor for a decrease

to.description: for set: the new value in the account currency

type.description: pause, enable, budget, bid or notify

maxChangesPerDay.description: how often this rule may change the same object in a day, 1-48 (default 1)

maxRaisePerDay.description: the most this rule may add to budgets in a day, account currency

conditions.description: when it acts. A value that cannot be measured (e.g. cpa with no conversions) never matches

metric.description: cost, impressions, clicks, conversions, conversions_value, ctr, cpc, cpm, cpa (= cost_per_conversion = cost_per_result), roas, conversion_rate, budget, bid — or ANY Google report metric as metrics.<field>, e.g. metrics.search_impression_share. Money is in the account currency

value.description: a number, or [low, high] for between

window.description: TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_14_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH … or "DAYS:N"; defaults to the rule's window

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend

quietHours.description: a window in which it never acts, e.g. 22:00-07:00

timezone.description: IANA name; default the ad account's

adGroupIds.description: only ads under these ad groups

campaignIds.description: only ad groups / ads under these campaigns

ids.description: a FIXED list of ids at that level; leave out for every object at the level (re-read every run)

level.description: campaign, adGroup or ad. Budgets live on campaigns, the manual CPC bid on ad groups

nameContains.description: only objects whose name contains this

statuses.description: ENABLED and/or PAUSED; default ENABLED (PAUSED for an enable rule)

name: update_google_ads_rule
title: Change a Google Ads automated rule
